name: Nina Weisswenger
original_name: ニーナ・バイスヴェンガー
source:
The daughter of Lydia, she is an excellent operator.

She has a good sense of humor and a keen eye for detail inherited from her mother. 
The people around her consider her to be an excellent officer, and she works hard every day to become a great soldier like her mother.

She doesn't trust the hero, and even hates him because she thinks his eyes and behavior are disgusting.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/23774#product-character]official website[/url]]
